[attribute-code-version]
=== `@code-version` Code Version

Version of this code.

#### Usage/Remarks
Note: The version of the language in which the code is written is recorded in the <<attribute-language-version,`@language-version`>> attribute.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-code,`<code>`>>, 
                  <<element-inline-code,`<inline-code>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Version of the program (code) that is shown inside the <<element-code,`<code>`>> element, for example, “`25.1 second patch`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
